title: Generated Image Provenance Handoff Record
description: Committed-safe contract for a generated-image provenance handoff record a reviewer reads alongside a local mock-image trial. The runtime smoke scripts/mock_generated_image_provenance_smoke.py writes a TEMP-ONLY object using absolute tempdir paths under a tempdir that is removed on exit — that runtime shape is NOT what this validator gates. THIS schema gates a committed-safe / package-safe version of the same shape (workspace-relative / placeholder paths only — no leading '/', no URI scheme, no '..' segment) so a synthetic example template and any committed reviewer-handoff record can be schema-validated without leaking absolute machine paths or real on-disk artifacts. The schema mirrors the runtime row taxonomy (id / placement_role / text_policy / subject_domain / manifest_local_path / spec / sidecar / asset / pptx_media) but no real PPTX bytes, no real assets, and no real D-One / MCP / public-network / model-API / image-search / Qoder run are produced or claimed. real_d_one_status is locked to a self-describing UNVERIFIED sentence; the validator's semantic gate refuses any positive success claim about real D-One / MCP / public network / model API / image search / Qoder anywhere in the record. schema_version is locked to '1' and evidence_id is locked to 'generated_image_provenance' so a future shape change forces a paired schema/validator bump. additionalProperties:false at every declared object level so a tampered record carrying an unrecognised field (smuggle slot) is refused at the schema layer.

schema_version.description: Record-file schema version. Locked to the string '1'; bumped only with a paired emitter + schema + validator change so a future consumer can refuse a shape it does not recognise.

evidence_id.description: Self-describing record identifier. Locked so a reader scanning a directory of mixed JSON evidence can recognise this record without inspecting the structure.

real_d_one_status.description: Fixed sentence pinned to the literal 'UNVERIFIED' substring AND explicit negation that real D-One / MCP / public network / model API / image search / Qoder / telemetry were called. The validator's semantic gate (G3) enforces the substring + negation in addition to the minLength/maxLength bounds the schema can express.

bundle_path.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path to the committed mock-image bundle the trial drove. Refuses leading '/', URI schemes, and '..' segments by pattern (validator G12 re-asserts at runtime).

workspace_path.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path the trial materialized assets under. Same path-shape rules as bundle_path.

report_dir.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path to the trial report directory. Same path-shape rules as bundle_path.

pptx_path.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path to the produced mock PPTX. Same path-shape rules as bundle_path.

path.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path to <report-dir>/mock_d_one_adapter_plan.json. Validator G12 refuses URI / traversal / absolute-output shapes.

schema_version.description: Locked sidecar plan schema version mirroring run_mock_image_pipeline.LOCKED_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION; refused when drifted (validator G16).

request_count.description: Number of requests recorded on the sidecar. The summary gate refuses a record whose request_count disagrees with len(rows).

ok.description: True iff the produced PPTX's inventory walker reported no findings.

findings_empty.description: True iff inventory.findings is an empty list. Cross-checked against ok by the validator.

slide_count.description: Number of slide parts in the produced PPTX.

relationships_external_count.description: Number of OOXML relationships whose Target carries a URI scheme OR whose TargetMode != Internal. Locked to 0 by validator G15.

id.description: Request id mirrored verbatim from the bundle's d_one_spec.json. Identifier-safe pattern; validator G6 refuses duplicate ids across rows.

placement_role.description: Closed enumeration mirroring scripts/done_image_adapter.py's placement_role surface. Both roles must appear across the rows (validator G7).

text_policy.description: Caller-declared text_policy on the spec. Lowercase-identifier shape; validator G8 refuses a rows[] where every value collapsed to one entry.

subject_domain.description: Caller-declared subject_domain on the spec. Lowercase-identifier shape.

manifest_local_path.description: Workspace-relative local_path mirrored from the manifest. Refuses leading '/', URI schemes, and '..' segments by pattern; validator G12 re-asserts at runtime.

placement_role.description: spec.placement_role mirrors the bundle's d_one_spec.json request value. Validator G9 refuses spec/sidecar/row drift.

intended_use.description: Free-text intended-use note mirrored from the spec. Validator G13 string-safety scan applies.

path.description: Workspace-relative or placeholder-safe path to the on-disk asset. Committed-safe contract: refuses leading '/', URI schemes, '..' segments (validator G12). NOTE: the runtime smoke records absolute tempdir paths here — that runtime shape is intentionally not gated by this committed-safe schema; the deliberate narrowed mapping is documented in references/quality-gates.md.

exists.description: True iff the recorded asset path resolved to a regular non-symlink file at evidence-write time.

byte_count.description: File byte length. Validator G10 refuses byte_count <= 0 on any row whose summary.ok is true.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-character hex sha256 of the asset bytes. Validator G10 refuses uppercase / non-hex / wrong-length values.

extension.description: Lower-cased file extension. Mirrors scripts/export_pptx.py's embed-surface allow-list (PNG / JPG / JPEG).

media_type.description: Conservative media-type projection from extension; validator G10 cross-checks the pair.

error.description: Empty string on a successful row; carries a per-row diagnostic when asset read failed. Validator G4 refuses summary.ok=true when any row carries a non-empty error.

part.description: Package-internal OOXML part path. Must sit under 'ppt/media/' (validator G11). The pattern refuses any URI scheme, '..' segment, or leading '/' by construction.

size_bytes.description: Byte length of the PPTX-embedded media part. Validator cross-checks against asset.byte_count is OUT OF SCOPE — the exporter renames and may pad on transcode-free embed; only sha256 byte-equality is gated (G11).

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-character hex sha256 of the PPTX media bytes. Validator G11 requires this to equal asset.sha256 byte-for-byte.

referencing_slides.description: Optional list of 1-based slide indices that reference this media part. Provenance-only; the validator does not require non-empty membership.

rows.description: One record per generated request, mirroring the runtime smoke's rows[] order. The schema enforces per-row required fields + identifier-safe id pattern + closed placement_role enum + closed extension / media_type / content_type enums + lowercase-identifier text_policy / subject_domain patterns; the validator enforces row-count >= 1, request_id uniqueness, placement_role coverage, text_policy diversity, spec/sidecar/row parity, sha256/byte_count/media-type shape, pptx_media sha equality, and committed-safe path shapes across every path-typed field.

scope.description: Fixed framing that names what this record does NOT prove (mock chain only, NOT real D-One / MCP / Qoder / public network / model API / image search / telemetry; not a prompt/report-to-PPTX automation). Validator G13 string-safety scan + G14 real-D-One claim refusal apply here too.

embed_surface.description: Fixed framing for the embed subset scripts/export_pptx.py supports today (PNG/JPG/JPEG under ppt/media/*). Anything outside that subset is fail-closed by the exporter.

ok.description: Single-boolean summary derived from every gate. Validator G4 refuses summary.ok=true when any of the documented sub-conditions does not hold.

row_count.description: Derived len(rows). Validator G4 refuses summary.ok=true when this disagrees with the actual length of rows[].

placement_role_coverage.description: Sorted unique placement_role values across rows. Validator G7 refuses summary.ok=true unless this equals exactly ['hero_page', 'local_region'].

text_policy_coverage.description: Sorted unique text_policy values across rows. Validator G8 refuses summary.ok=true unless this carries at least two distinct entries (a rows[] that collapsed to a single text_policy — typically all 'no_text' — is refused).

failures.description: Per-gate failure strings the in-script gate stack produced. A summary.ok=true record MUST carry an empty failures[].
